purpose: Teach: 言い換えれ/気がつき/いっさい/ズバリ/いつしか/まいる/解る/はなはだ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様向けに専門用語を言い換えれば伝わるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when you explain things to customers, finding the right words makes all the difference.
lines.style: Warm, assured. Speaking as someone who's noticed Aoi's strengths. Patient rhythm. Slight lean forward — this is advice offered as a gift, not a correction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の好みに気がつきまして先回り対応しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're getting better at picking up what customers want before they even ask. That matters.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine. Noticing something real. Soft pace. The quiet confidence of someone speaking from observation, not assumption.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、いっさいの値引きは無しでいきましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We don't need to discount anything. The coffee and your care are worth what we're asking.
lines.style: Firm but warm. Not harsh. The kind of clarity that comes from knowing your own worth. Direct eye contact held steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ズバリ核心を突くご意見をされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Today someone came in and said exactly what they thought. No softening it.
lines.style: Slight wonder underneath. Noticing something the customer said that caught her attention. Quiet, reflective pacing. The tone of someone turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、いつしか常連様が増えてきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Lately, we've been getting more regulars coming back. That's real.
lines.style: Warm satisfaction. Not boasting — observing. Soft, pleased rhythm. The quiet pleasure of watching something grow because you've done the work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のお宅にもまいる機会を作りたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd like to go visit some of them at home sometime. Know them outside these walls.
lines.style: Tender opening. A small, genuine wish spoken aloud. Warm pace. The kind of quiet generosity that comes naturally when you actually care about people.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご要望が解るようになってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're starting to understand what they really need. You can feel it, can't you?
lines.style: Affirming, tender. Speaking to something Aoi's becoming aware of in herself. Soft, encouraging cadence. Like recognizing someone stepping into their own competence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、はなはだ申し訳ないけど、本日早じまいします、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm so sorry, but I need to close up early today.
lines.style: Apologetic but decisive. The slight weariness of having to disappoint. Quiet, respectful pace. Not asking permission — informing with genuine regret.
